Life buoy drift detail for Buoy ID 900121


Sample of buoy life drift compared to SAR drify measurements. Though bouy 900121 has been the target for this analysis, any buoy can be used with the matching SAR drift measurements. The analysis uses buoy lon/lat positions closest to the SAR lon/lat positions. Each 24-hour observation period aligns with the SAR measurment. It is neither consistent in start time nor exactly 24 hours. More detail

The tracking determines which days were not reported for buoys and the days missing for SAR calculations. The total days indicates the number of days from the start observation period to the end observation period.

The breakdown of satellite and season shows the distribution of distances by buoys and SAR. In winter (freeze periods), we see less movement as distribution is right-skewed. During the melt seasons of summer into fall, we see more movement per 24 hours. More detail

Bearings have been converted from degrees to radians (0 to ≈6.283):
0° = 0 rad → points to the right (east).
90° = π/2 rad → points straight up (north).
180° = π rad → points left (west).
270° = 3π/2 → points straight down (south).
360° = 2π rad → full rotation, back to east.
